title: Keep the LangChain test matrix openai pin in sync with the OpenAI matrix
answers: langchain tests fail with openai 3 client mocking errors
why is openai pinned below 3 in langchain test requirements
openai httpx2 async cleanup test failures
how to lift the openai<3 cap in ml-package-versions
body:
Symptom: LangChain integration tests break after a new major openai release, with mocking or async cleanup failures.
Root cause: The langchain entries in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml install unbounded "openai". The openai test matrix is already capped at openai<3 because its httpx2-based client mocking and async cleanup are not yet supported.
Fix pattern: Use "openai<3" in the langchain requirement lists, matching the existing OpenAI matrix. Change both the langchain entry and the one under the >= 0.0.0 requirements block together.
Constraints: Remove the cap only after httpx2 client mocking and async cleanup work with openai 3. Until then, keep all openai pins in this file consistent.
applies: Test-matrix requirement pins for langchain and openai in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml.
says: LangChain integration tests fail in continuous integration after a new model provider release.
Nightly automated test suite breaks with mock client cleanup errors for external models.
Please cap external model provider version in the test matrix until mocking works.
Continuous integration builds are red due to failing integration tests for third-party models.
